knowledge_gaps: Architecture provenance is unresolved: the required sasrec_perdataset baseline and supplied code analysis do not establish a transition branch. Historical diagnostic metrics cannot establish that the current checkpoint contains one. Specify the actual scoring decomposition and a concrete fallback when the branch is absent.

The evaluation lifecycle is incomplete. The host evaluates working/predict.py after train.py finishes; the pseudocode assumes validation feedback is available inside the alpha loop. Explain how three trial-local predictor configurations share one frozen checkpoint, receive independent host evaluations, and export the selected configuration.

Graph construction is insufficiently specified for reproduction: user-fold assignment, edge weighting, pruning, normalization, deployment averaging, and gate computation are missing. Verify alpha=1 reconstruction and predictor parity using the deployed graph, including unsupported edges, padding, and category-local item IDs.

Residual scaling measures branch utility at a fixed checkpoint, but does not establish that diagnostics improve search efficiency or address the qualitative current-intent concerns. Keep those claims separate. An inference ablation also cannot replace a retrained branch-free comparison.

Specify top-10 turnover, score-parity tolerances, checkpoint selection, and budget allocation. Three validation comparisons remain adaptive selection; a single changed hit changes macro HR@10 by 0.00125. Originality 3/10 is reasonable, potential 6/10 is conditional, and difficulty 3/10 is justified only if the branch and host evaluation orchestration already exist.

The RecPack Tests citation needs bibliographic verification: the supplied report and background disagree about its year, and a conference-session link does not identify the exact implementation or supported checks.
